scenarios.prompt: We ran a price test. Before: 1000 units sold at $100. After: raised price to $115, units dropped to 820. How price-sensitive is this product? Report elasticity (signed) and abs_elasticity.

An econometrician gave me this: at the current price P=$50, quantity Q=2000, and the slope of the demand curve dQ/dP = -30. What's the elasticity of demand at this point? Report elasticity and abs_elasticity.
